title: C++: Schema Validator
description: Build a schema validator that validates data against a defined schema.

steps.title: Schema Validator
steps.description: Define a FieldType enum (INT, STRING, DOUBLE). Create a FieldRule struct with name, type, min, max. Create a Field struct with a variant value. Write a bool validate function that checks each field against its rule. Test with age:int(0-150) and name:string(1-50).
hints: enum class FieldType { INT, STRING, DOUBLE };
struct FieldRule { string name; FieldType type; double min, max; };
Use variant<int, string, double> for field values.
Check int: val >= min && val <= max. Check string: length >= min && length <= max.

verification.failureMessage: Validate fields and print OK or INVALID
